remakes.sub: Remade by ballhallaa with a leaderboard on every course. The beta codes add hints, splits, spectating, and translations.
classic.title: Classic courses
classic.sub: More Wrecking Ball parkour from Spiz, Fasteroid, and Senimar.
courses.note: Struck-through codes have been broken since Overwatch’s August 2026 patch.
lb.submit.title: Submit a video of your run
lb.submit.sub: Open a ticket on the Ballkour Discord and share your video. New to the server? Join it first.
f.run.title: One continuous run
f.run.text: Clear every checkpoint in order, from start to finish, with one total time at the end.
f.mistakes.title: Mistake counter
f.mistakes.text: Missing a checkpoint or dying to the map counts. Your total sits next to your time.
f.rules.title: Checkpoint rules
f.rules.text: Some checkpoints block or utilize only Grapple, Shield Bounce, and/or Piledriver.
f.practice.title: Skip, go back, freemode
f.practice.text: Practice any checkpoint, or roam the map with the clock paused.
f.lobby.title: Lobby leaderboard
f.lobby.text: On the Ballkour remakes, the top 10 times hang in the lobby and the finish screen shows the time to beat.
f.qol.title: Quality of life
f.qol.basics: Hold to restart a checkpoint or your whole run, pause anytime and resume later, and get a bhop of grace on every checkpoint.
f.qol.afk: Idle runners shrink so they never block your view.
f.hints.title: Hints
f.hints.text: A recorded route shows you the way through. Turn hints on yourself, or they switch on after 10 mistakes on one checkpoint.
f.spectate.title: Spectate
f.spectate.text: Watch other runners in first or third person, or fly in freecam mode.
f.splits.title: Splits
f.splits.desc: Best and average times for every checkpoint, so you can see where you lose time.
f.pace.title: Pace
f.pace.text: Your estimated finish time, updated live from your average split. It turns red when you fall behind.
f.scorecards.title: Scorecards
f.scorecards.text: See every runner’s checkpoint, time, and mistakes live, along with the lobby’s top 3.
f.translations.text: Translated into 13 languages, so each player gets the full experience in their own language.
dc.blurb: Submit runs for the leaderboard, get notified on updates, and meet fellow ballers!
src.gameReleases.title: Game release notes
tr.about: This website and Ballkour’s beta builds are translated into 13 languages on Weblate. Fluent speakers are welcome to review and improve the translations there.
tr.fix.title: Found a translation error?
foot.disclaimer: Ballkour is a fan-made Overwatch Workshop mode. It isn’t affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.
steps.1: In Overwatch, open Play → More → Custom Games → Create.
steps.2: Go to Settings → Import Code (under Summary), and paste the code (e.g. 59W28).
